title: CVE-2023-21237: Android Pixel Information Disclosure Vulnerability

title: CVE-2021-36380: Sunhillo SureLine OS Command Injection Vulnerablity

title: CVE-2024-21338: Microsoft Windows Kernel Exposed IOCTL with Insufficient Access Control Vulnerability
